# biznetgio_object_storage_buckets (Data Source)

List buckets inside an Object Storage instance.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "biznetgio_object_storage_buckets" "example" {
  account_id = biznetgio_object_storage.example.id
}

output "names" {
  value = [for b in data.biznetgio_object_storage_buckets.example.buckets : b.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) Object Storage instance account id.

### Read-Only

- `buckets` (Attributes List) List of buckets. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--buckets))

<a id="nestedatt--buckets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `buckets`

Read-Only:

- `acl` (String) Canned ACL.
- `name` (String) Bucket name.
- `raw` (String, Sensitive) Full JSON of the item.
